bugs.title: Unsanitized Search Query Parameter in PostgREST .or() Filter
bugs.description: The search endpoint passed raw query strings directly into supabase .or() filter (`title.ilike.%${q}%,short_description.ilike.%${q}%`). Special PostgREST delimiters such as commas, parentheses, or quotes would trigger PostgREST filter syntax parse errors (HTTP 500).
bugs.fix: Added regex sanitization `rawQ.replace(/[,()"]/g, ' ').trim()` to prevent query delimiter collisions.

bugs.title: Unfiltered Product Query in Dynamic XML Sitemap
bugs.description: The dynamic sitemap generator queried products without explicit status filtering, which risked exposing draft or archived items to search engine crawlers.
bugs.fix: Added `.in('status', ['active', 'featured', 'published'])` constraint to ensure only public canonical products are included in sitemap.xml.

bugs.title: Missing Cleanup for Pending Navigation Timeout on Unmount
bugs.description: CategoryNavStrip used a 200ms grace window for mouse hover transitions via timeoutRef without cleaning up pending timers when the component unmounted.
bugs.fix: Implemented React.useEffect cleanup hook returning `() => clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current)` on unmount.

bugs.title: Unchecked Background Polling on Inactive Browser Tabs
bugs.description: The real-time audit log live feed polled the Supabase backend every 5 seconds even when the browser tab was minimized or hidden.
bugs.fix: Added `document.visibilityState === 'visible'` check before triggering periodic background log queries.

bugs.title: Missing Google Image XML Namespace & Tags
bugs.description: Product images were not declared in sitemap.xml with `<image:image>` tags, slowing down Google Image Search discovery.
bugs.fix: Added `xmlns:image="http://www.google.com/schemas/sitemap-image/1.1"` namespace and `<image:image><image:loc>...</image:loc></image:image>` tags for all catalog products.
